why_ENV_0_is_a_closure_and_not_a_detecti: REGISTERED BECAUSE IT IS THE PART THAT GENERALISES. A DETECTION IS A LIST; A CLOSURE IS AN INVARIANT. The two coverage-lie rules are detections: each catches one known way a suite can lie and each cost a specific past failure to learn, so a list of them is always incomplete in exactly the direction that matters -- the failure not yet met. ENV-0 converts EVERY unforeseen termination into a named outcome with a checkpoint WITHOUT ANTICIPATING THE FAILURE; it requires only that the instrument be honest about having one. IT BELONGS BESIDE CLAUDE.md RULE 3, NOT BESIDE THE OTHER TWO: rule 3 closes the FALSE NEGATIVE (an instrument that reports nothing wrong because it looked at nothing); ENV-0 closes the SILENCE (an instrument that reports nothing at all). WHAT GENERALISES IS ENV-0's FORM, NOT ITS INSTANCE -- adopting 'add an EXIT trap to shell scripts' is the cheapest and least valuable reading of it.
